title: SKILL.md frontmatter, Claude Code extended profile
description: Every field Claude Code documents for a skill, and nothing else. Claude Code itself ignores a field it does not recognize without reporting an error, so a misspelled key (when-to-use, argument_hint) silently does nothing; this profile makes it a finding. All fields are optional in Claude Code. A skill bound here is NOT upload-safe: the extension fields fail claude.ai upload and the Skills API; bind skills you upload to the spec-strict profile instead. Project policy on top of the vendor rules: `description` is required (Claude Code only recommends it, and falls back to the body's first line) — which also makes a skill whose opening --- is not on line 1, and whose frontmatter Claude Code therefore ignores, a finding instead of a silent pass.

x-source.revision: unversioned documentation page; field table as retrieved

x-source.note: the six shared fields keep the spec's constraints

name.description: Command name; defaults to the directory name (Claude Code). Spec constraints kept.

description.description: Claude Code truncates description + when_to_use at 1,536 chars combined in the skill listing; this bound covers description alone (the combined sum is on the recipe's can't-check list).

argument-hint.description: Autocomplete hint. The reference gives examples ([issue-number]) but no type; written unquoted, [x] parses as a YAML list, so a list is accepted rather than reported (how Claude Code renders one is undocumented).

disable-model-invocation.description: Claude Code accepts true/false and, from v2.1.218, yes/no/on/off/1/0 in any case.

user-invocable.description: Claude Code accepts true/false and, from v2.1.218, yes/no/on/off/1/0 in any case.
